# Implementation traces — completed 2026-10-08

Owner-requested filename date retained. Companion to the [canonical audit](GODS_EYE_CAPABILITY_IMPLEMENTATION_RECONCILIATION_2026-10-05.md). Every audited area has all 30 required stages. These are source-navigation candidates and curated core comparisons, not 2,010 live tests. Regex excerpts can concern a different kind of priority, timer or metadata than the requested stage. For non-core stages not established by curated anatomy, semantics remain UNKNOWN/N/A; an excerpt is not proof of that behavior. Exact line excerpts and exported symbols make the traces checkable. `declaration_hint` is a nearby lexical declaration, not a claim that each step has a separate callable API. Factory/module symbols and target hashes are in the machine inventory. No matching hook is explicitly N/A/UNKNOWN rather than invented.

**Upstream implementation:** WFIGS current incident polygon normalization, containment styling and incident cards; InciWeb link checking, source timestamps and footprint selection.

## flights — Civil aircraft acquisition / motion / display

**Upstream implementation:** OpenSky worldwide snapshot with observer/view-anchored ADSB.lol fallback; enrichment and track backfill; geometric/barometric/ground policy, delayed motion, LOD/model budgets and follow camera.

**Hub relationship:** HUB IMPLEMENTATION QUESTIONABLE; OpenSky and fallback chain, view anchor/250-NM fallback, history/motion interpolation, enrichment, heading/classification, aircraft tracking, global contact display. Aircraft glyph hidden above 2,000,000 m and its point never shown.

## satellites — Satellite populations / propagation / tracking

**Upstream implementation:** Six core CelesTrak groups plus optional Starlink dense catalog, NORAD dedupe, cached satellite.js records, wall-clock SGP4, PointPrimitiveCollection, orbit rings, ISS labels/follow, chunked dense load.

**Hub relationship:** HUB IMPLEMENTATION QUESTIONABLE; Five core groups plus dense opt-in, category styles, NORAD multi-group dedupe, persistent satrec, 1-second propagation and per-frame tracked updates, orbit rings and partial/stale catalog state. Hard cap 100; 15-second position updates.

## weather-satellite — Weather satellite / regional-global cloud imagery

**Upstream implementation:** NOAA GOES regional cloud image plus global LWIR product; clouds-only/full-IR controls, observed frame history and coverage-aware rendering. Global LWIR is not a validated cloud mask.

## weather-current — Modeled point weather

**Upstream implementation:** Open-Meteo current point normalization; upstream cockpit regional briefing and location-specific visual weather effect, not one global Weather layer.

**Hub relationship:** HUB IMPLEMENTATION QUESTIONABLE; Upstream cockpit weather fields/effects and independent visible weather products. Hub requests four current variables, renders a 16px point, displays temperature/cloud/valid time but omits requested wind from facts.

## terrain-heights — Terrain / mesh floor / altitude sampling

**Upstream implementation:** Bounded cache/batching, datum-aware ellipsoidal samples and geoid-only degraded fallback; optional photoreal mesh floor sampling informs entity/camera placement.

**Hub relationship:** HUB IMPLEMENTATION JUSTIFIED; Terrain batch service/groundFloor, mesh floor resolution and provenance; Hub camera uses globe.getHeight or 0 fallback without a terrain-height service.

## basemaps — Global imagery / base-map switching

**Upstream implementation:** Five selectable stacks: Google3D, Bing Aerial, Bing Labels, Esri World Imagery and OSM. MapSourceController switches asynchronously with generations/cache/credits and keyless fallback.

**Hub relationship:** HUB IMPLEMENTATION JUSTIFIED; Provider stack tray/global HD. Hub qualified CONUS USGS with GIBS/NaturalEarth coarse globe fallback and bounded requests.
